Remember, O LORD, what has happened to us. Look and see our disgrace!
Be merciful to me, O LORD; see how my enemies afflict me! Lift me up from the gates of death,
I will delight in Your statutes; I will not forget Your word.
Consider my enemies, for they are many, and they hate me with vicious hatred.

verses.text: Defend my cause and redeem me; revive me according to Your word.

xrefs.text: Of David. Contend with my opponents, O LORD; fight against those who fight against me.
Because I have sinned against Him, I must endure the rage of the LORD, until He argues my case and executes justice for me. He will bring me into the light; I will see His righteousness.
May the LORD be our judge and decide between you and me. May He take notice and plead my case and deliver me from your hand.”
Their Redeemer is strong; the LORD of Hosts is His name. He will fervently plead their case so that He may bring rest to the earth, but turmoil to those who live in Babylon.
How I long for Your precepts! Revive me in Your righteousness.

verses.text: Salvation is far from the wicked because they do not seek Your statutes.

xrefs.text: His sons are far from safety, crushed in court without a defender.
He came and preached peace to you who were far away and peace to those who were near.
There is no one who understands, no one who seeks God.
For You save an afflicted people, but You humble those with haughty eyes.
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and discipline.

verses.text: Great are Your mercies, O LORD; revive me according to Your ordinances.

xrefs.text: But You, O Lord, are a compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness.
For great is Your loving devotion to me; You have delivered me from the depths of Sheol.

I will make known the LORD’s loving devotion and His praiseworthy acts, because of all that the LORD has done for us— the many good things for the house of Israel according to His great compassion and loving devotion.

For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. When Nathan the prophet came to him after his adultery with Bathsheba. Have mercy on me, O God, according to Your loving devotion; according to Your great compassion, blot out my transgressions.
David answered Gad, “I am deeply distressed. Please, let us fall into the hand of the LORD, for His mercies are great; but do not let me fall into the hands of men.”

verses.text: Though my persecutors and foes are many, I have not turned from Your testimonies.

xrefs.text: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast and immovable. Always excel in the work of the Lord, because you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain.
The arrogant utterly deride me, but I do not turn from Your law.
I only know that in town after town the Holy Spirit warns me that chains and afflictions await me.
Yet a righteous one holds to his way, and the one with clean hands grows stronger.
My feet have followed in His tracks; I have kept His way without turning aside.

verses.text: I look on the faithless with loathing because they do not keep Your word.

xrefs.text: Rage has taken hold of me because of the wicked who reject Your law.
Do I not hate those who hate You, O LORD, and detest those who rise against You?
My eyes shed streams of tears because Your law is not obeyed.
“Go throughout the city of Jerusalem,” said the LORD, “and put a mark on the foreheads of the men sighing and groaning over all the abominations committed there.”
Jesus looked around at them with anger and sorrow at their hardness of heart. Then He said to the man, “Stretch out your hand. So he stretched it out, and it was restored.

verses.text: Consider how I love Your precepts, O LORD; give me life according to Your loving devotion.

xrefs.text: Oh, how I love Your law! All day long it is my meditation.
Look upon my affliction and rescue me, for I have not forgotten Your law.

Then I instructed the Levites to purify themselves and guard the gates in order to keep the Sabbath day holy. Remember me for this as well, O my God, and show me mercy according to Your abundant loving devotion.
“Please, O LORD, remember how I have walked before You faithfully and with wholehearted devotion; I have done what is good in Your sight.” And Hezekiah wept bitterly.
Remember me favorably, O my God, for all that I have done for this people.

verses.text: The entirety of Your word is truth, and all Your righteous judgments endure forever.

xrefs.text: Every word of God is flawless; He is a shield to those who take refuge in Him.
All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for instruction, for conviction, for correction, and for training in righteousness,
Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live.
For I tell you truly, until heaven and earth pass away, not a single jot, not a stroke of a pen, will disappear from the Law until everything is accomplished.
Your righteousness is everlasting and Your law is true.

verses.text: Rulers persecute me without cause, but my heart fears only Your word.

xrefs.text: and said to Saul, “Why do you listen to the words of men who say, ‘Look, David intends to harm you’?
Though my persecutors and foes are many, I have not turned from Your testimonies.
And he continued, “Why is my lord pursuing his servant? What have I done? What evil is in my hand?
Has not My hand made all these things? And so they came into being,” declares the LORD. “This is the one I will esteem: he who is humble and contrite in spirit, who trembles at My word.
Be angry, yet do not sin; on your bed, search your heart and be still. Selah

verses.text: I rejoice in Your promise like one who finds great spoil.

xrefs.text: Your words were found, and I ate them. Your words became my joy and my heart’s delight. For I bear Your name, O LORD God of Hosts.
The law from Your mouth is more precious to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
Your testimonies are my heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.

So he led David down, and there were the Amalekites spread out over all the land, eating, drinking, and celebrating the great amount of plunder they had taken from the land of the Philistines and the land of Judah.
You have enlarged the nation and increased its joy. The people rejoice before You as they rejoice at harvest time, as men rejoice in dividing the plunder.

verses.text: I hate and abhor falsehood, but Your law I love.

xrefs.text: Therefore I admire all Your precepts and hate every false way.
Love must be sincere. Detest what is evil; cling to what is good.
There are six things that the LORD hates, seven that are detestable to Him:
Remove me from the path of deceit and graciously grant me Your law.
Hate evil and love good; establish justice in the gate. Perhaps the LORD, the God of Hosts, will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph.”

verses.text: Seven times a day I praise You for Your righteous judgments.

xrefs.text: At midnight I rise to give You thanks for Your righteous judgments.
Morning, noon, and night, I cry out in distress, and He hears my voice.
Zion hears and rejoices, and the towns of Judah exult because of Your judgments, O LORD.
Mount Zion is glad, the daughters of Judah rejoice, on account of Your judgments.
For His judgments are true and just. He has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her immorality. He has avenged the blood of His servants that was poured out by her hand.

verses.text: Abundant peace belongs to those who love Your law; nothing can make them stumble.

xrefs.text: My son, do not forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments;
The work of righteousness will be peace; the service of righteousness will be quiet confidence forever.
You will keep in perfect peace the steadfast of mind, because he trusts in You.
Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled; do not be afraid.
And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.

verses.text: I wait for Your salvation, O LORD, and I carry out Your commandments.

xrefs.text: I await Your salvation, O LORD.
I long for Your salvation, O LORD, and Your law is my delight.
My soul faints for Your salvation; I wait for Your word.
I wait for the LORD; my soul does wait, and in His word I put my hope.
By this we can be sure that we have come to know Him: if we keep His commandments.

verses.text: I obey Your testimonies and love them greatly.

xrefs.text: For in my inner being I delight in God’s law.
I delight to do Your will, O my God; Your law is within my heart.”
“This is the covenant I will make with them after those days, declares the Lord. I will put My laws in their hearts and inscribe them on their minds.”
Whoever has My commandments and keeps them is the one who loves Me. The one who loves Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love him and reveal Myself to him.
Consider how I love Your precepts, O LORD; give me life according to Your loving devotion.

verses.text: I obey Your precepts and Your testimonies, for all my ways are before You.

xrefs.text: For a man’s ways are before the eyes of the LORD, and the LORD examines all his paths.
You search out my path and my lying down; You are aware of all my ways.
If we had forgotten the name of our God or spread out our hands to a foreign god,
For His eyes are on the ways of a man, and He sees his every step.
“Can a man hide in secret places where I cannot see him?” declares the LORD. “Do I not fill the heavens and the earth?” declares the LORD.

verses.text: May my cry come before You, O LORD; give me understanding according to Your word.

xrefs.text: Now if any of you lacks wisdom, he should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to him.
Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live.
In my distress I called upon the LORD; I cried to my God for help. From His temple He heard my voice, and my cry for His help reached His ears.
if you truly call out to insight and lift your voice to understanding,
Now grant me wisdom and knowledge, so that I may lead this people. For who is able to govern this great people of Yours?”

verses.text: May my plea come before You; rescue me according to Your promise.

xrefs.text: May Your loving devotion come to me, O LORD, Your salvation, according to Your promise.
Hear my cry for mercy when I call to You for help, when I lift up my hands toward Your holy sanctuary.
And now, O LORD God, confirm forever the word You have spoken concerning Your servant and his house. Do as You have promised,
I have found My servant David; with My sacred oil I have anointed him.
Then Jacob declared, “O God of my father Abraham, God of my father Isaac, the LORD who told me, ‘Go back to your country and to your kindred, and I will make you prosper,’

verses.text: My lips pour forth praise, for You teach me Your statutes.

xrefs.text: Blessed is the man You discipline, O LORD, and teach from Your law,
When I sing praise to You my lips will shout for joy, along with my soul, which You have redeemed.
I will praise You with an upright heart when I learn Your righteous judgments.
O Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will declare Your praise.
O God, You have taught me from my youth, and to this day I proclaim Your marvelous deeds.

verses.text: My tongue sings of Your word, for all Your commandments are righteous.

xrefs.text: We know that the law is spiritual; but I am unspiritual, sold as a slave to sin.
Let no unwholesome talk come out of your mouths, but only what is helpful for building up the one in need and bringing grace to those who listen.
So then, the law is holy, and the commandment is holy, righteous, and good.
You brood of vipers, how can you who are evil say anything good? For out of the overflow of the heart the mouth speaks.
The mouth of the righteous man utters wisdom, and his tongue speaks justice.

verses.text: May Your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen Your precepts.

xrefs.text: Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will surely help you; I will uphold you with My righteous right hand.
Then Joshua told them, “You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen to serve the LORD.” “We are witnesses!” they said.
I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you today that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing. Therefore choose life, so that you and your descendants may live,
I am Yours; save me, for I have sought Your precepts.
Uphold me, and I will be saved, that I may always regard Your statutes.

verses.text: I long for Your salvation, O LORD, and Your law is my delight.

xrefs.text: I wait for Your salvation, O LORD, and I carry out Your commandments.
I will delight in Your statutes; I will not forget Your word.
I rejoice in Your promise like one who finds great spoil.
I delight in Your commandments because I love them.
Your testimonies are my heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.

verses.text: Let me live to praise You; may Your judgments sustain me.

xrefs.text: Incline your ear and come to Me; listen, so that your soul may live. I will make with you an everlasting covenant— My loving devotion promised to David.
Deliver me from bloodguilt, O God, the God of my salvation, and my tongue will sing of Your righteousness.
The living, only the living, can thank You, as I do today; fathers will tell their children about Your faithfulness.
Yes, we wait for You, O LORD; we walk in the path of Your judgments. Your name and renown are the desire of our souls.
The LORD disciplined me severely, but He has not given me over to death.

verses.text: I have strayed like a lost sheep; seek Your servant, for I have not forgotten Your commandments.

xrefs.text: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost.
We all like sheep have gone astray, each one has turned to his own way; and the LORD has laid upon Him the iniquity of us all.
“What man among you, if he has a hundred sheep and loses one of them, does not leave the ninety-nine in the pasture and go after the one that is lost, until he finds it?
I have other sheep that are not of this fold. I must bring them in as well, and they will listen to My voice. Then there will be one flock and one shepherd.
For “you were like sheep going astray,” but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
